primaryChecks.text: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

context.text: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
